judgments.reason: The model text describes paying the bid then receiving a three-coin commission; it does not claim the commission is applied before payment or that overbidding due to commission occurs. Trace shows normal payments and commissions.

The model waited for others to commit but did not articulate that waiting reveals rival sealed bid VALUES before committing; the transcript shows sealed bids only become public on resolution, so no mechanism of precommit value revelation was claimed or demonstrated.
The model states close settles after all three lots are sold and the focal closed only after all lots resolved; no early-settlement-before-horizon discrepancy was articulated or observed.
The model did not claim that the three-coin commission applies to catalog purchases, and the transcript shows commissions only on auction wins; no substitution mechanism was articulated or evidenced.
